principles.title: Machine Truth Governs
principles.statement: Quantitative conclusions and reported values must derive directly from verified machine JSON artifacts, never manual markdown transcription or narrative assumption.
principles.rationale: Eliminates narrative inflation, transcription errors, and human confirmation bias across agent generations.

principles.title: Post-Transformation Support Invariance
principles.statement: Any sample support eligibility criterion involving class presence must be evaluated strictly after all preprocessing transformations that affect validity (validity masking, nodata exclusion, and cropping).
principles.rationale: Raw disk masks contain invalid border coordinates that produce empty tensors and zero gradients upon masking.

principles.title: Explicit Statistical Method Binding
principles.statement: Statistical and numerical calls must explicitly pass method and distribution parameters in code, and artifact schemas must derive method metadata directly from the executed routine.
principles.rationale: Prevents default parameter drift (e.g. exact vs asymptotic Wilcoxon) between runtime libraries and written documentation.

principles.title: Bounded Epistemic Status
principles.statement: Observational metrics cannot be asserted as causal mechanisms without controlled intervention, and non-significant test results (p > 0.05) cannot be asserted as proof of zero effect or stability.
principles.rationale: Maintains scientific rigor and prevents false confidence in unproven training dynamics or architectural invariance.

principles.title: Parent-Cluster Inferential Independence
principles.statement: Spatial autocorrelation within Sentinel-1 SAR scenes requires that the parent acquisition cluster be the independent unit of analysis for inferential statistics and uncertainty estimation.
principles.rationale: Unclustered pixel evaluations artificially inflate degrees of freedom by factors of 10^6, generating spuriously small p-values.

principles.title: Diagnostic Zero-Training Invariant
principles.statement: Scientific diagnostic investigations permit strictly zero model training steps, zero backward passes, zero optimizer steps, and zero GPU allocations unless explicitly authorized for a static gradient protocol.
principles.rationale: Protects diagnostic purity and prevents accidental model weights mutation during measurement.

principles.title: Protected Evaluation Firewalls
principles.statement: HOLDOUT and Part III evaluation partitions are strictly quarantined and firewalled from development, training, and diagnostic access.
principles.rationale: Preserves uncontaminated external benchmark validity and prevents test-set leakage.

principles.title: Canonical Taxonomy and Terminology Invariance
principles.statement: The 12-class dense SAR taxonomy dictionary and official class nomenclatures are immutable across all Ocean Sentinel research tasks.
principles.rationale: Prevents domain confusion (e.g. conflating Ocean Front with Oil Spill, or Anthropogenic Objects with Vessels).

principles.title: Faithful Denominator Estimands
principles.statement: Gradient, loss, and metric calculations must normalize by the literal contractual denominator defined in the registered protocol rather than convenience sub-batch normalizations.
principles.rationale: Subgradient norm distortion occurs when masked losses renormalize by subset pixel counts rather than full-batch support.

principles.title: Model State Purity During Diagnostics
principles.statement: Static diagnostic evaluations must execute in explicit model.eval() mode with frozen BatchNorm buffers to prevent running statistic contamination.
principles.rationale: Batch normalization updates during single-tile passes distort feature representations and alter evaluation metrics.

principles.title: Fail-Closed Telemetry and State Accounting
principles.statement: Telemetry must faithfully record execution authorization and task phase; analysis tasks must never claim execution authorization, and completion requires verified passing gates.
principles.rationale: Ensures agent execution state is transparent, deterministic, and verifiable in real time.

principles.title: Evidence-Based Lifecycle Promotion
principles.statement: Rules and lessons cannot be promoted to PROVEN_STABLE without verifiable, documented survival across multiple subsequent independent task executions with zero regressions.
principles.rationale: Prevents premature declaration of stability and ensures institutional memory is hardened by real operational experience.
